events.title: Little Sheep Valley is in Steam Next Fest: Tailor Shop & Ranch House Update! 🐑
events.summary: Hello everyone 👋We're excited to be part of Steam Next Fest! To celebrate, we've rolled out a big update to the Little Sheep Valley demo 🎉Sheep customizationsBuild a tailor shop on your ranch and dress up your sheep! From colourful blankets and noble top hats to shiny earrings. You can now make your sheep look cute and fancy! 🎩 Ranch House & DecorationsYour ranch house can now be extended with modular pieces, and you can place decorations on walls to make your home even cozier. events.title: We'll exhibit @ Gamescom
events.summary: Hello everyone 👋Let me start once again with a big thank you to everyone who has left a Steam review on our demo so far! ❤️ Your review is one of the most impactful ways you can support Little Sheep Valley at the moment.We'd love to meet you at Gamescom! Next week, we'll be exhibiting Little Sheep Valley at Gamescom in Cologne, Germany, and we would love to welcome you to our booth. events.title: Demo Patch 0.2.1
events.summary: Hey everyone! This is the first small patch for the demo that we released yesterday. First of all: Thank you so much for playing the demo and providing us with feedback! If you have any more – don't hesitate to share it on our Discord.
